_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2023 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2023 10-K, under 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks.', says 'At the same time, our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers. Pricing and delivery models are evolving.' and 'These costs will reduce the operating margins we have previously achieved.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'We are devoting significant resources to develop and deploy our cloud-based strategies.' The stock trades at 45.6x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

Live: Microsoft's own FY2023 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'We expect AI technology and services to be a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market.' and that some companies compete with it 'using open source AI models' ('Some open source products mimic the features and functionality of our products.') It sells generative AI of its own: 'We are investing in artificial intelligence (“AI”) across the entire company and infusing generative AI capabilities into our consumer and commercial offerings.' The stock trades at 45.6x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Microsoft's software seats or search specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2023 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +128% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.45; conservative 2yr -27%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY14-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.3%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.3%/yr (FY14-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2024-06-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (63.3% downside to Bear $164 / +-6.9% upside to Bull $416) | Adj composite 2.32 vs market 3.77: gap -1.45 [OVERVALUED] | +128% above the EPP floor $196 (20x FY24E $9.81) | Conservative 2-yr case: -27.4% total (-13.7%/yr) | At 45.6x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $591 sits above the BULL case; unearned revenue +13.2% in Q3 FY24, forward revenues +17% (no Q4 FY24 revenue guide, Q3 FY24 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
